_about: Hazard library for the risk finder: known, recurring hazards with where (places) and when (months; empty: any time). Centre and radius only draw the zone on the map; the finder matches on places. Hand-curated for the prototype (JAPAC, the Gulf, the Red Sea route); to be replaced by maintained sources.

hazards.name: Southwest monsoon floods (Sri Lanka)
hazards.note: Floods and landslides in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.

hazards.name: Northeast monsoon floods (Sri Lanka)
hazards.note: Floods in the Northern and Eastern provinces; cyclones in some years.

hazards.name: Dry-zone drought (Sri Lanka)
hazards.note: Failed rains hit paddy farmers and water supply.

hazards.name: Kerala monsoon floods
hazards.note: Floods and landslides across central and northern Kerala.

hazards.name: Northeast monsoon cyclones (Tamil Nadu and Andhra coast)
hazards.note: Cyclones and floods on the Coromandel coast, including Chennai.

hazards.name: Mumbai monsoon floods
hazards.note: Urban flooding that halts work and transport.

hazards.name: North India heatwave
hazards.note: Extreme heat: farm output, power demand, outdoor work.

hazards.name: Bay of Bengal cyclones (Bangladesh, Odisha, West Bengal)
hazards.note: Cyclones and storm surge.

hazards.name: Pakistan monsoon floods
hazards.note: Riverine floods across Sindh and Punjab.

hazards.name: Nepal monsoon floods and landslides
hazards.note: Landslides that cut roads and remittance-dependent towns.

hazards.name: Philippine typhoon season
hazards.note: Typhoons and floods.

hazards.name: Thailand monsoon floods
hazards.note: Floods in the central plains, including industrial estates.

hazards.name: Japan earthquakes and typhoons
hazards.note: Earthquakes any time; typhoons August to October.

hazards.name: Gulf security tension
hazards.note: Military tension and attacks on shipping in and around the Gulf; affects migrant jobs, remittances and oil.

hazards.name: Strait of Hormuz disruption
hazards.note: A closure or attacks raise oil prices and the import bill.

hazards.name: Red Sea shipping attacks
hazards.note: Attacks near Bab-el-Mandeb push ships around Africa: longer voyages, higher freight.

hazards.name: Taiwan Strait tension
hazards.note: Shipping and electronics supply chains.

hazards.name: Sanctions on payments to Russia
hazards.note: Bank restrictions make it hard for buyers to pay for imports (tea, garments).

hazards.name: Sanctions on Iran
hazards.note: Payments for exports to Iran can be blocked.

hazards.name: US tech hiring slowdown
hazards.note: US clients cutting technology outsourcing budgets hits IT-services income in India.

hazards.name: China property and demand slowdown
hazards.note: Weaker demand for imports from South and Southeast Asia.

hazards.name: Dengue season (South Asia)
hazards.note: Hospital claims and lost work days.

hazards.name: Monsoon and typhoon floods (Metro Manila)
hazards.note: Habagat rains and typhoons flood Metro Manila and Calabarzon; work and transport stop.

hazards.name: Rainy-season floods (Jakarta)
hazards.note: Floods from the wet monsoon; land subsidence makes them worse.

hazards.name: Forest-fire haze (Sumatra and Kalimantan)
hazards.note: Peatland fires in the dry season; haze closes schools and airports across the region.

hazards.name: Chao Phraya floods (central Thailand)
hazards.note: River floods in Bangkok's north; the 2011 floods shut industrial estates.

hazards.name: Typhoons and floods (northern Vietnam)
hazards.note: Typhoons from the Gulf of Tonkin; Yagi (2024) hit Hai Phong and Hanoi.

hazards.name: Drought and saltwater intrusion (Mekong Delta)
hazards.note: Low river flows let seawater into the delta; rice and fruit farmers lose crops.
